content:
One of my favourite Apple TV 4K features—the screensaver—is reportedly getting sound effects in tvOS 27. Here's what we know so far.

Code from tvOS 27 indicates that at least one Apple TV screensaver will be getting a sound option, with more expected to follow.

October looks set to be a big month for Apple, with a slew of new hardware and software products expected.

In addition to the rumoured new Apple TV 4K, an image of leaked Apple internal code has also surfaced.

On the software side, leaker pdfu has just revealed evidence found in the tvOS 27 codebase showing that at least one Apple TV screensaver will support sound effects.

As seen in the video above, there's a hidden option in the Snoopy screensaver to turn sound on or off, or use a "reduced" setting.

The Snoopy screensaver demo doesn't look too distracting, but I'm glad Apple plans to let users turn the sound off completely.

Although pdfu hasn't found other screensavers with sound support yet, Apple is likely to extend the feature to more screensavers.

What are your thoughts on tvOS 27 potentially adding sound options to Apple TV screensavers? Share your thoughts in the comments section.
